dz: 为了重新征服莫斯科，金帐汗国的埃米尔埃迪古到达莫斯科，烧毁了城市周围的地区，但未能占领城市本身。
de: Seeking to resubjugate Muscovy, Emir Edigu of the Golden Horde reaches Moscow, burning areas around the city but failing to take the city itself.

t: 拉蒙·贝伦盖尔二世(Ramon Berenguer 二世),巴塞罗那伯爵被刺杀,最有可能是被他…
te: Ramon Berenguer II, Count of Barcelona is assassinated, most likely by his brother, Berenguer Ramon II.
dz: 拉蒙·贝伦盖尔二世(Ramon Berenguer 二世),巴塞罗那伯爵被刺杀,最有可能是被他的兄弟贝伦盖尔·拉蒙二世所杀.
de: Ramon Berenguer II, Count of Barcelona is assassinated, most likely by his brother, Berenguer Ramon II.

t: 约旦裂谷地震摧毁了黎凡特一带多座城市,引发了海啸并造成多人死亡.
te: The Jordan Rift Valley earthquake destroys multiple cities across the Levant, triggers a tsunami and kills many.
dz: 约旦裂谷地震摧毁了黎凡特一带多座城市,引发了海啸并造成多人死亡.
de: The Jordan Rift Valley earthquake destroys multiple cities across the Levant, triggers a tsunami and kills many.

t: 托莱多第四理事会开幕,由塞维利亚的伊西多尔主持.
te: Fourth Council of Toledo opens, presided over by Isidore of Seville.
dz: 托莱多第四理事会开幕,由塞维利亚的伊西多尔主持.
de: Fourth Council of Toledo opens, presided over by Isidore of Seville.

t: 西塞罗发表第四篇、也是最后一篇《反喀提林演说》。
te: Cicero gives the fourth and final of the Catiline Orations.
dz: 西塞罗发表第四篇、也是最后一篇《反喀提林演说》。
de: Cicero gives the fourth and final of the Catiline Orations.
